subject: french

moments.title: Treaty of Rome
moments.body: France is a founding member of the European Economic Community.

moments.title: Schengen Agreement
moments.body: France signs Schengen near the Luxembourg border. Passport-free travel follows in 1995.
moments.takeaway: Borders within Europe became more porous.

moments.title: Euro launched
moments.body: The franc gives way to the euro for currency in 1999 and notes/coins in 2002.
moments.takeaway: France gave up monetary sovereignty for European integration.

now.title: EU and France now
now.body: France remains a central EU player. Macron promotes 'European sovereignty'. Far-right Euroscepticism rises.
now.open_questions: What does French leadership of the EU look like next?

reflection: France's borders feel different than they did 50 years ago.
